text: The amounts of one academic year tuition fee of different subjects: (per person) Chinese Language Training RMB￥15000 Undergraduate program Liberal arts Science & Engineering Medical Science RMB￥ 16000 RMB￥ 19000 RMB￥ 22000 Master’s program RMB￥ 20000 RMB￥ 25000 RMB￥ 30000 Living costs: Accom- modation Two students share Four students share Facilities On campus Hostel (two bedrooms) RMB￥32 per day/ per student RMB￥16per day/ per student air-conditioner, color TV, card telephone, internet Access, Bathroom, western toilet, beds, desks & chairs, book shelf, wardrobe, kitchen, water heater, washing machine and refrigerator Meals Approximately RMB￥10-20 a day per person Notes: 1. An excellent foreign student can apply for a scholarship of RMB￥2,000-RMB￥10,000 annually. 2. All fees are calculated by RMB and can be paid in Chinese Yuan (RMB) or US dollars. 3. Costs of travel, residence permit, medical insurance, textbooks, and telephone bills are at the expense of the students. 4. The tuition fees and accommodation fees are paid off before the students’ registration.
